author: More Perfect Union
description:
Elon Musk just took over 130,000 acres of public land in Louisiana.

After secret deliberations conducted behind the cover of NDAs, Governor Landry just handed SpaceX a beautiful parcel of land, a $27.5 billion tax break, and legal immunity.

Locals say the 30 rockets a day the site will launch will devastate the pristine coast, while the richest man in the world reaps the profits.
title: How Elon Musk used NDAs to take 130,000 acres of public land in a secret $100 billion deal

author: More Perfect Union
description:
We took Ro Khanna to Pennsylvania to talk to workers about AI, and how it could kill their jobs.

The Silicon Valley lawmaker’s district is getting rich off AI.

We sat him down with workers who share the fear of millions of Americans — that AI could take everything.
